Class CockroachDBContinuumAutoConfiguration

java.lang.Object
com.cockroachlabs.data.continuum.autoconfigure.CockroachDBContinuumAutoConfiguration
@AutoConfiguration(after=CockroachDBAutoConfiguration.class) @ConditionalOnClass(DataSource.class) @EnableConfigurationProperties(CockroachDBContinuumProperties.class) public class CockroachDBContinuumAutoConfiguration extends Object
Auto-configuration for the Cockroach Continuum surfaces: vCluster tagging, Plenum storage insights, Aegis (simulated by default), and the agent/MCP tool surface. Runs after CockroachDBAutoConfiguration so the shared JdbcTemplate is available.
